subject: Chief Briefing: Eclipse Systems demo — scheduling & fallback plan
messages:
From: Daniel Park <d.park@eclipsesys.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: sales@eclipsesys.com
Date: 2028-07-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + chief-level briefing request — Eclipse Systems x Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie / Marissa,

Thanks for taking the call last week. Eclipse is ready to move from discovery to an executive briefing with our CIO and VP of Platform to validate performance and SLAs before the procurement window opens next month. High-level asks:
- 45–60 minute live demo focused on throughput, latency on 2k context and multi-tenant isolation.
- A brief product/ops Q&A for our security team (SOC2 / KMS questions).

Ideal attendees from your side: a senior product/solutions person + an engineering lead who can answer quant/latency questions. From our side: CIO Daniel Park (I), VP Platform Alexandra Tran, and one security engineer.

Suggested windows (PST):
• Tue Jul 11 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
• Wed Jul 12 — 08:30–09:30 or 13:30–14:30

Attached is our RFI spreadsheet (eclipse_rfi.xlsx) with initial technical checkpoints. Do you have a preferred slot? Also please share a short run-of-show so we can align internal stakeholders.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Daniel Park
CIO, Eclipse Systems
Attachment: eclipse_rfi.xlsx (xlsx)
From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Daniel Park <d.park@eclipsesys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + chief-level briefing request — Eclipse Systems x Redwood Inference

Thanks for the details, Daniel — this is great context. I can run the briefing and Marissa (VP, Customer Success) will join for sponsorship and commercial Q&A. A couple quick asks so we can scope the run-of-show:

1) Which of the listed windows is highest priority for your CIO? If none, share two concrete options and we’ll pick and send an invite.
2) Will the security engineer be presenting SOC2 items, or are you asking for a replayable artifact (SOC2 summary + KMS integration docs)?
3) Any specific benchmarking workloads you want us to demonstrate (e.g., chat completion multi-user, embeddings batch)?

Internal note: VP-level availability is limited on Jul 11 AM; if we can’t get a direct VP time, we’ll propose a backup where Vivek Kulkarni (Head of Solutions) joins as a delegate.

Proposed slots we can definitely cover (PST):
• Tue Jul 11 — 15:00–15:45 (we can compress to 45m)
• Wed Jul 12 — 08:30–09:15
• Thu Jul 13 — 11:00–11:45

If one of those works, we’ll send an ics invite and a one-page run-of-show. I’ll also attach a brief draft agenda for your review.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Principal, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the quick reply. CIO prefers Wed Jul 12 but 13:30–14:30 PST works better for his calendar if you have a slightly later window (we can stretch to 60 minutes). If Jul 12 at 13:30 is impossible on your side, Jul 13 at 11:00 is our second preference.

We’ll plan to have:
- Daniel Park (CIO) — primary decision maker
- Alexandra Tran (VP Platform) — technical follow-up lead
- Sophie Lin (security engineer) — SOC2/KMS questions (she’ll cover the RFI rows 4–8)

Link to our availability: https://calendly.com/eclipsesys/demo-45

We can also share an internal one-pager on evaluation criteria ahead of time. I’ll upload it to the Google doc you shared once we confirm the slot.

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-08T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Jul 12 13:30–14:30 PST — Chief Briefing (run-of-show & fallback)

Thanks — we’ve locked Wed Jul 12, 13:30–14:30 PST for the executive briefing. Calendar invite (ics-chief-briefing-invite.ics) and a short agenda (eclipse-demo-agenda.pdf) attached.

Confirmed attendees from Redwood:
- Stephanie Nguyen — lead (product & live demo)
- Marissa Cole — VP, Customer Success (commercial / SLA discussion)
- Vivek Kulkarni — Solutions lead (backup for technical deep-dive)

From Eclipse: Daniel Park, Alexandra Tran, Sophie Lin (security).

Run-of-show (high level):
1) 5m — introductions and goals
2) 20m — live demo (2k context throughput + multitenant isolation patterns)
3) 15m — targeted benchmarking results & architecture Q&A (Marissa/Vivek answer infra + cost controls)
4) 15m — security and SLA discussion (Sophie to cover SOC2/KMS items)
5) 5m — next steps and procurement cadence

Fallback plan: if a senior is delayed, Vivek will take the deep-technical portion; we’ll run a shortened 30-minute briefing focusing on the top 3 buying criteria and follow up with a recorded deeper session for the security team.

Next steps:
- I’ll send a shared Google doc with a 1-page checklist for post-demo follow-up and ownership. (link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcdef-demo-plan)
- Please confirm any additional attendees by EOD Jul 10 so we can prepare environment and role-based demos.

Attachments: eclipse-demo-agenda.pdf, ics-chief-briefing-invite.ics

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Principal, Solutions — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
